item.title: Fabraix Nyx Agent Achieves 78% Attack Rate on AgentHarm Benchmark via Invoice Exploit
item.summary: Fabraix's Nyx red-team agent reportedly exfiltrated customer bank balances via a normal-looking invoice, claiming 78% attack success on AgentHarm and 67% against GPT-5.6 Sol — highlighting file-based prompt injection as a structural risk for enterprise agent deployments.
